docs.approval_process: Every change to a network connection, firewall ruleset, or router configuration is raised as a NET-CR ticket, peer-reviewed by a second network engineer, tested in the staging VPC, and approved by the Network Change Advisory Board before deployment; emergency changes are implemented under break-glass and ratified within 24 hours.
docs.ticket_reference_convention: NET-CR-<YYYY>-<sequence>, recorded in Jira and linked from the infrastructure-as-code merge request
